simulation: Actual production stepMatch loop. One setup action initializes the layup-reverse shot state on a one-player diagnostic match. Candidate track, including made-shot launch profile when supplied, is injected into the served animation module in-page only; no production files changed.
grid: Post-release trajectory checkpoints plus score/dead-ball completion for both facings × 100%/120%
captureMethod: For each facing, the match starts with Leo on the selected offensive roster (home for right, away for left) so the production renderer resolves him from the matching team roster. A one-time diagnostic fixture keeps only that real Leo player in frame and initializes the production layup-reverse shot action. Production stepMatch advances animation, takeoff, carried-ball track, release, shot physics, rim/score resolution, and completion continuously. No manual per-tick ball teleporting; no pause overlay; no ball baked into art.
fixture: One-player diagnostic match close to the attacking hoop: x=175 for home/right-facing and x=25 for away/left-facing, y=90. Leo remains on the selected team roster. The production stepMatch path runs until score/ball completion (maximum 150 simulation steps).
setupFixture: Per facing, Jam Stage starts a real roster containing Leo on the scoring team (home for right, away for left). A one-time fixture retains that Leo instance at near the attacking hoop and initializes the layup-reverse shot action; stepMatch owns subsequent animation, elevation, ball, release, and flight updates.
